46Chapter 46 · Ek asli product, aur ek naukri

Asli Log, Asli Use

Demo tab tak chalta hai jab tak aap dekh rahe hote hain. Asli product ko tab chalna hota hai jab koi nahi dekh raha, un logon ke liye jinka aap par koi haq nahi. Spring mein Anaya guard ko ajnabiyon ke liye taiyaar karti hai. Woh imaandaar early users dhoondhti hai aur bina madad kiye unhe dekhti hai. Phir jo dekha, uski wajah se ek change ship karti hai. Aap design partner, informed consent, observation session, changelog aur support log seekhte hain.

11 min padhai5 naye shabd

Is chapter mein

  • batana ki ajnabiyon ke product use karne se pehle kya taiyaar hona chahiye, aur ek owner ka naam likhna
  • aise design partners dhoondhna jo impress na hone ke liye azaad hon, aur unka informed consent likhit mein lena
  • ek observation session chalana, aur logon ki kahi baat ko unke kiye se tolna
  • problems ko kitni baar, kitni buri aur kitni mehngi se score karna, ek tay ummeed ke saath ek change ship karna, aur ek changelog aur ek support log rakhna

April ke aakhri Thursday ko, raat ke 2:10 baje, Imran Qureshi ka phone cheekh utha. Awaaz aisi thi jaise kisi chhote jaanwar par paer pad gaya ho. Yeh alert usne khud isi kaam ke liye lagaya tha. Ek pal woh andhere mein leta raha aur sochta raha ki alert kitna achha chal raha hai. Phir woh uth baitha.

Alert ne kaha ki demo page par errors ek line paar kar gaye hain. 2:30 tak use wajah mil gayi: ek certificate expire ho gaya tha. (Certificate ek digital badge hai. Woh saabit karta hai ki website asli hai.) 2:45 tak usne use theek kar diya. 3 baje usne log mein chaar lines likhi. (Log ek diary hai ki kya galat hua.) Phir woh wapas so gaya. Woh us aadmi jaisa tha jiska smoke alarm wahi kaam kar gaya jiske liye khareeda gaya tha.

Naashte par usne Anaya ko bataya ki "ready" ka matlab yehi hota hai. Kuch galat hua, aur use sabse pehle pata chal gaya.

46.1Case: ready, aur kisi ke naam

Anaya ko pichhle hafte tak lagbhag poora hafta lag gaya yeh baat samajhne mein. Demo tab chalta hai jab koi dekh raha ho. Product ko tab chalna hota hai jab koi nahi dekh raha. Yeh dukaan ke opening day jaisa hai. Maal chhota hissa hai. Taale, bijli aur fire exit utne hi zaroori hain.

Imran ne use ek chhoti list di. Usne use table bana liya. Woh saal bhar Imran ki mez ke upar chipka raha.

Har row par bahes hui thi. Har ek mein bas ek dopahar lagi. Jis par kisi ne bahes nahi ki, woh aakhri thi. July mein model provider ka bill aaya. (Provider woh company hai jiska model guard use karta hai.) Us number ko dekhkar Mr. Bhatia ne chai neeche rakh di.

Har system ka ek owner bhi chahiye. Yeh ek naam wala insaan hota hai jo bure waqt par kuch tootne par jawaab deta hai. Guard ke liye, har mahine ka pehla hafta Imran ka tha aur doosra Tanvi ka. Unke phone number us page par the jo batata tha ki fault kaise report karein. Product Anaya ka tha. Isliye agar owners ko baar-baar jagana pade, toh wajah dhoondhna uska kaam tha.

46.2Sach bolne wale log dhoondhna

Kit try karne wale pehle log ajnabi nahi the. Woh Anaya ki behen ki saheli aur do purane colleagues the. Ek aur ladka tha, uski building ka, jo computer mein achha tha. Sab bade pyaar se pesh aaye. "Bahut pyaara hai," saheli ne kaha. "Bahut smart."

Kuch din baad Anaya ne ek baat dekhi. Unmein se kisi ke kehne se product mein kuch nahi badla. Dost bahut shaleen hote hain, isliye kaam ke nahi hote. Yeh dinner par mehmaanon se poochne jaisa hai ki khana kaisa hai. Woh "lovely" kehte hain, aur dobara nahi aate. Woh banane wale ko wahi sunate hain jo woh sunna chahta hai.

Toh usne woh kiya jo doosre mahine mein seekha tha. Woh spring mein jin logon ka interview kiya tha, un tak gayi, aur unke jaanne walon tak. Usne aise log dhoondhe jinhe abhi yeh problem thi aur jo isi tarah ka software use karte the.

Use chhe teams mili. Ek Kochi ki travel company thi jiski chat passport numbers se bhari thi. Ek Indore ki clinic-booking service thi. Ek Bengaluru ka chhota tutoring business tha. Teen aur bhi judi.

Usne unhe design partners kaha. Design partner ek early user hota hai. Woh ek adhoore product ko use karne aur banane wale ko imaandaari se batane par raazi hota hai ki use kya mila. Woh abhi customer nahi hain. Woh test audience bhi nahi hain.

46.3Usne unhe pehle kya bataya

Kisi ke kit chhune se pehle, Anaya ne har partner ko ek page bheja. Lakshmi Iyer ne use do baar padha aur do jagah theek kiya. Table dikhata hai ki page mein kya likha tha, aur har line ka saada matlab kya tha.

Yeh informed consent hai. Ise school trip ki permission slip ki tarah sochiye. Maa-baap ko bataya jaata hai ki bus kahan jaayegi, kya galat ho sakta hai aur kise phone karna hai. Tab woh haan kehte hain. Isi tarah insaan tab haan kehta hai jab use saaf bataya jaye ki kya collect hota hai aur kahan jaata hai. Use yeh bhi sunna hota hai ki kya galat ho sakta hai aur wapas kaise liya jaye. Yeh kisi box par click nahi tha. Yeh ek insaan tha jo samajh raha tha ki woh kis par haan keh raha hai, aur jaanta tha ki woh chhod sakta hai.

Badle mein Anaya ne early access aur pehle saal ke liye kam daam diya. Usne usse zyada dene ka socha, aur Lakshmi ne use roka. Agar partners ko bahut zyada paisa diya jaye, toh woh sochte hain ki unhe taareef karni hai. Team ko woh log chahiye the jo impress na hone ke liye azaad hon.

46.4Haath dabaa kar baithna

May ke pehle hafte mein, Anaya ne chhe logon ko kit use karte dekha. January mein usne paanch developers ko bhi isi tarah dekha tha, haath peeche bandhe. Ise observation session kehte hain. Yeh kisi dost ko apni rasoi mein bina madad kiye khana banate dekhne jaisa hai. Dekhne wala kisi ko ek asli kaam deta hai aur chup rehta hai. Har baar woh wahi kuch cheezein likhta hai. Kaam mein kitna time laga? Insaan kahan ruka? Usne zor se kya kaha? Usne kaun si anokhi cheez aazmai? Kya woh poora kar paya?

Use yeh lagbhag dard jaisa laga. Indore ka ek aadmi chalis second tak ek setting ko ghoorta raha. Woh setting tay karti thi ki kaun si kism ki detail chhupayi jaaye. Use saaf nahi pata tha ki woh kya karti hai. Anaya bolna itna chahti thi ki usne apne gaal ke andar ka hissa kaat liya.

Hafte ke ant tak uske paas ek baat ka saboot tha jis par use bahut pehle se shak tha. Log jo kehte hain aur jo karte hain, woh do alag sources hain, aur woh ek doosre se nahi milte. Kochi ke Joseph ne call par kaha ki guard "bahut aggressive" hai. Usne kaha woh bahut kuch chhupa deta hai.

Analytics (users kya karte hain, uske number) ne kuch aur kahani batayi. Uski team ne teen hafton mein restore button do baar dabaya tha. (Yeh button chhupayi hui detail wapas laata hai.) Ek aur partner ne kaha use yeh bahut pasand hai. Usne baarah din mein kit ko sirf ek call ki thi.

Mukhya vichaar

Jab dono alag hon, toh behaviour par bharosa kijiye

Karan is boring hisse mein uske saath juda tha. Usne niyam aise rakha: behaviour par bharosa kijiye, phir kyun poochiye. Behaviour batata hai ki sach kya hai. Wajah aapko poochni padti hai. Anaya ne Joseph se poocha ki use kyun laga ki woh bahut zyada chhupata hai. Woh hans pada. "Mujhe lagta hai ek baar maine use ek postcode chhupate dekha," usne kaha, "aur maan liya ki woh josh mein hai."

46.5Samay se zyada problems

Do hafte baad uske paas pareshaniyon ka ek page tha. Kuch machine ki failures thi. Kuch ek aisa button thi jo kisi ko mila hi nahi. Woh unhe do lists mein nahi rakhna chahti thi. Galat judgement aur uljhi hui screen user ka utna hi bharosa todti hain.

Yeh help desk par shikayatein piles mein baantne jaisa hai. Usne har problem ko teen cheezon par score kiya. Kitne logon ko mili? Jab mili, toh kitni buri thi? Use theek karna kitna mehnga hoga?

Table ne ek thanda paani ka chheenta diya. Jo problem ek customer ko poori tarah rokti hai, woh hamesha us problem se upar nahi hoti jo chupke se chaar ko pareshaan karti hai. Kitni baar aur kitni buri, alag-alag taraf kheenchte hain. Kharch tay karta hai ki kisi ka jawaab kitni jaldi milega.

46.6Ek change, aur usse kya ummeed thi

Sabse upar wali row kehni aasaan thi aur theek se karni mushkil. Chhe mein se chaar teams ne kisi na kisi tarah poocha tha ki detail kyun chhupayi gayi. Guard ko wajah pata thi aur usne kabhi batayi nahi. Anaya ne plan ek card par likha. Yeh recipe card jaisa hai. Woh batata hai ki kya banayenge, kiske liye, aur kaise pata chalega ki theek bana. Usne wahi form use kiya jo Imran ne use sabhi plans ke liye sikhaya tha.

Hal kiya hua udaharan

Card

Humne dekha ki chhe mein se chaar teams ne poocha ki detail kyun chhupayi gayi. Aur review karne walon ne chhupayi gayi details mein se sirf 100 mein 58 ko sahi mana. Hum ek "yeh kyun chhupaya gaya" link jodenge jo woh teen phrases dikhaye jinhone faisla kiya.

Hum ummeed karte hain ki sahi maane gaye ka hissa do hafton mein 65 se upar jaayega, aur har message par koi extra time nahi lagega. Agar woh nahi hilta, toh pareshani faisle mein ho sakti hai, samjhaane mein nahi. Tab hum kuch aur badalne se pehle pachaas vivadit cases haath se padhenge.

Anaya ko aakhri line par sabse zyada naaz tha. Usne use kisi result se pehle likha tha. Matlab yeh tha ki agar number nahi hilta, toh use pehle se pata tha ki kya karna hai. Number badhkar 67 ho gaya.

46.7Logon ko batana ki kya badla

Change ek Thursday ko ship hua. Anaya ne use waise likha jaise uske pasandida products likhte hain. Lift ke paas lagi notice board sochiye: "Mangalvaar ko paani band, 10 se 12." Yeh changelog hai. Yeh har release mein kya badla, uski chhoti public list hai. Yeh user ke liye likhi jaati hai, banane wale ke liye nahi.

Hal kiya hua udaharan

Changelog entry

Naya: "Yeh kyun chhupaya gaya?" Kisi bhi masked detail ke paas chhote sawaal ke nishaan par click kijiye. Aap woh teen phrases dekhenge jinse faisla hua. Agar woh galat tha, toh Restore dabaiye, aur humein bataiye.

Entry ne bataya ki kya naya hai. Usne bataya ki use kaise karein. Usne bataya ki woh galat chale toh kya karein. Usmein yeh nahi likha tha "masking subsystem ki explainability behtar ki". Tanvi ne use proofread kiya. Usne sirf ek shabd kaata aur uski jagah chhota shabd rakha.

Anaya ne us hafte ek aur kaam kiya jo ship karne ke baare mein nahi tha. Usne ek support log shuru kiya. Yeh help desk ke register jaisa hai. Kisi bhi partner ki madad ki har request ek sheet mein gayi, category aur account ke saath. Isme kuch kharch nahi hua. Ek mahine baad use samajh aaya ki yeh uski ab tak ki sabse sasti research thi. Users bina poochhe bata rahe the ki unhe kya chahiye.

Mondays ko woh aur Karan log ko analytics ke saath padhte. Kuch pareshani support log, observation sessions aur numbers, teeno jagah ek saath dikhti. Woh lagbhag pakka asli thi. Sirf ek mein dikhne wali pareshani par woh nazar rakhti.

46.8Saar

Demo tab chalta hai jab koi dekh raha ho. Asli product ko tab chalna hota hai jab koi nahi dekh raha. Iske liye chhe cheezein chahiye. Alerts jo kisi insaan tak pahunchein. Live system se aate events. Ek privacy notice. Fault batane ka ek click wala tareeka. Ek aisa rollback jo aazmaya gaya ho. Kharch ki limit. Aur ek naam wala owner.

  • Early users woh hon jinhe abhi problem hai aur jo banane wale ko nirash karne ke liye azaad mehsoos karein. Dost aisa kam hi karte hain. Unhe saaf, likhit mein bataiye ki kya collect hota hai, kahan jaata hai aur kaise chhodein. Kuch fair dijiye, kuch bada nahi.
  • Observation session mein dekhne wala ek asli kaam deta hai aur chup rehta hai. Woh har baar wahi cheezein note karta hai. Jab log jo kehte hain aur jo karte hain alag ho, toh behaviour par bharosa kijiye. Phir kyun poochiye.
  • Problems ko kitni baar, kitni buri aur kitni mehngi se score kijiye. Machine ki failures aur uljhi screens ko ek hi list mein rakhiye.
  • Ek change ko saboot, ummeed ke asar aur na chalne par plan ke saath ship kijiye. Use saade shabdon mein announce kijiye. Madad ki har request rakhiye. Support requests, sessions aur numbers mein ek saath dikhne wali problem asli hoti hai.

Aakhri chapter product se hatkar use banane wale insaan aur job ki taraf jaata hai.

Mukhya shabd

Saral matlab, usi kram mein jis kram mein aap inse milenge.

design partner
ek dost jaisa tester, jaise padosi jo aapki nayi recipe chakhkar sach batata hai. Ek early user jo adhoore product ko aazmata hai aur badle mein kuch fair paakar imaandaari se batata hai ki use kya mila
informed consent
school ke trip wali permission slip jaisi cheez. Insaan tab haan kehta hai jab use saaf bataya jaye ki kya collect hota hai, kahan jaata hai, kya galat ho sakta hai aur wapas kaise liya jaye
observation session
jaise kisi dost ko apni rasoi mein bina madad kiye khana banate dekhna. Aap kisi ko ek asli kaam dete hain, use karte dekhte hain, aur har baar wahi cheezein note karte hain
changelog
lift ke paas lagi notice board jaisa, jo batata hai is hafte kya badla. Har release mein kya badla, iski chhoti public list, jo users ke liye likhi jaati hai
support log
help desk ka register. Madad ki har request ki ek chalti list, category aur account ke saath, jise har hafte product ke saboot ki tarah padha jaata hai

Aur gehraai mein

Kahan is chapter ke ideas ne asli duniya mein kuch tay kiya, aur woh kis research se aate hain.

Asli duniya mein

  • Klarna’s AI assistant handles two-thirds of customer service chats · OpenAI customer story, 2024

    Sabse mashhoor support deployment: ek mahine mein 23 lakh chats. Ise un baad ki khabron ke saath padhiye ki Klarna ne log wapas rakhe.

  • Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149 · BC Civil Resolution Tribunal, 2024

    Ek airline ke chatbot ne refund ka niyam khud bana diya aur airline ko use maanna pada. Chatbot jo kehta hai uski zimmedaari company ki hai.

Research

  • Generative AI at Work · Brynjolfsson, Li and Raymond, NBER, 2023

    5,000 support agents ke saath ek AI assistant: har ghante 14% zyada issues hal, aur zyadatar fayda naye agents ko.
